calculation.description: Ranks assets by the negative of their trailing 60-observation return, normalized by trailing 20-observation daily volatility. Inputs use only completed observations available at the decision date; positive values favor medium-term laggards for contrarian allocation.

validation.regime_notes: Positive contrarian IC in all reported online-era regimes: 0.096163 (2026-07-16 to 2027-12-31), 0.037532 (2028-01-01 to 2029-12-31), 0.130110 (2030-01-01 to 2032-12-31), and 0.029254 (2033-01-01 to 2034-10-12). Small 15-asset cross-section; uncertainty should be interpreted conservatively.
